discrepancies: perf_hooks.md:2978 recordCorrected says it backfills values 'between the previously recorded value and val'. Behavior (main, v26.13.0): every call records val, val-i, val-2i, ... down to i, independent of earlier records (recordCorrected(1000,100) on an empty histogram records 10 values; 950 then 1000 records 19).
perf_hooks.md:2118 burnRate 'Requires the histogram to have been created with both halfLife and threshold'. Behavior: without them it returns 0 and does not throw.
perf_hooks.md:1758-1768 createHistogram halfLife/threshold options have no changes: entry; version of introduction undocumented.
perf_hooks.md:2367 ewmaMean lists added: v26.8.0 only, while ewmaStddev/ewmaErrorRate/burnRate list v26.8.0, v24.21.0. Unverified on v24.21+ (no binary available); treated as not on v24.
perf_hooks.md:2309 export() lists added: v26.9.0 only, while importHistogram (1829) lists v26.9.0, v24.22.0. Unverified on v24.22 (no binary available).
perf_hooks.md:1940 monitorEventLoopDelay lowest/highest/figures (v26.11.0): on older versions (verified v24.19.0) they are silently ignored rather than rejected (figures: 9 accepted).

perf_hooks.md:2439/2453 linearBuckets/logBuckets say 'map of bucket boundary values to counts'; behavior: keys are inclusive upper bounds (key k counts values in (k - step, k]; logBuckets first key holds all values <= firstBucket).
perf_hooks.md:2920 add(other) does not reject histograms with a different figures configuration (observed: silently accepted).
